# myCHEF Dubai

myCHEF Dubai is a premium private chef and luxury catering experience coordinator based in Dubai, UAE. We design bespoke dining experiences for homes, villas, yachts, and corporate venues, then match each booking with an independent, vetted chef or catering team to execute the menu and service.

## What we do

- Private chef dinners and tasting menus at home or in a villa
- Luxury catering for weddings, birthdays, corporate events, and celebrations
- Yacht catering for cruises around Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah
- Corporate drop-off and full-service catering, including meal-prep retainers
- Weekly meal prep and part-time / full-time private chef placements
- Halal-first, allergen-aware, and dietary-specific menus
- Live cooking stations, buffets, canapé receptions, and grazing tables

## How it works

1. Share your occasion, guest count, venue, dietary needs, and budget.
2. We design a tailored menu and service plan.
3. A vetted independent chef or team prepares and serves the meal.
4. We handle coordination, booking protection, and post-event follow-up.

- Response time: typically within 15 minutes during business hours
- Insurance: AED 5 million liability coverage
- Cuisine styles: Arabic, Mediterranean, Italian, Indian, Asian, sushi, vegan, vegetarian, halal, healthy, and more
- Typical private chef dinner: from AED 350 per person
- Typical corporate lunch: from AED 45 per person
- Full-time private chef: AED 18,000–35,000+ per month plus employment costs

## Important notes

- myCHEF Dubai coordinates and designs the experience; the actual food preparation is carried out by independent licensed chefs and catering businesses.
- All regulatory food-safety requirements (trade licence, food-handler training, and Dubai Municipality Food Code compliance) sit with the executing chef or caterer.
- Halal certification and sourcing policies should always be confirmed in writing before booking.
